headline: Department cycle completed: profile fixes, growth evidence and a visual demo storyboard.
summary: Department responsibilities and ranked dispatch queue are now durable: Product Design, Engineering & Delivery, Growth & Marketing, Social & Creative, coordinated by CEO/Operations. Three existing agents worked in parallel and received follow-up tasks after review. HQ reports actual snapshots, not always-on department claims.

Product delivered three fixes: visible Edit profile entry, accurate save state with locked fields during pending requests and cleared stale confirmation, and a billing-configured-only Plus link to Settings. Verified 1,209 web tests (14 skipped), production build/typecheck, scoped lint and actual-component mobile/desktop browser checks. Local only.

Growth prepared the next experiment from the already approved five-organization host packet and assessed measurement readiness. Existing mutable request/seat records cannot establish historical acceptance denominators; attendance/return still need scoped aggregate measurement and explicit fixture/staff exclusions. No outreach or invented traction.

Social prepared one 20-second demo script and a self-contained four-frame visual storyboard. Coordinator rejected initial overlap; corrected desktop/mobile layouts were checked. Fictional demo is clearly labeled; no finished video or public post is claimed.

Retained host editing independently passes five focused tests, three browser variants and isolated typecheck; broader integration remains next. Production is unchanged. Recurring CLI remains quota-faulted and is not active; current-session agents do not establish continuous background operation. No paid fallback, deployment or external campaign publication.
